faqs.question: What services does Dodo Cares provide?
faqs.answer: We offer a wide range of services including grooming, spa & bath, daycare, training, vet consultation, pet boarding, and pet taxi. Our goal is to provide complete care for your furry family members.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can easily book an appointment through our website's booking page by selecting your desired service and preferred time slot, or by contacting our support team.

faqs.question: Is prior appointment required for all services?
faqs.answer: While walk-ins are welcome based on availability, we highly recommend booking a prior appointment to ensure dedicated time for your pet without waiting.

faqs.question: What are your center's operating hours?
faqs.answer: Our center is open every day from Monday to Sunday, from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you provide pet pickup and drop services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer convenient pet taxi and pickup/drop services within our service areas for grooming, daycare, and vet visits.

faqs.question: What safety measures do you follow for pets?
faqs.answer: We follow strict sanitation standards, 24/7 CCTV monitoring, supervised play areas, and trained medical first-aid staff to ensure total safety for your pet.

faqs.question: Can I visit the center before booking?
faqs.answer: Yes! You are most welcome to visit our center for a quick tour and meet our team before booking any service for your pet.

cookiePolicySec.intro: At Dodo Cares, we believe in being clear and open about how we collect and use data related to you. This Cookie Policy explains how and why we use cookies on our website.

sections.title: What Are Cookies
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us remember your preferences, enhance site navigation, and provide a seamless browsing experience.

sections.title: How We Use Cookies
sections.content: Dodo Cares uses cookies to analyze website traffic, remember your appointment preferences, improve our pet care services, and deliver relevant information tailored to your pet's needs.

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content: We use Essential Cookies (required for site functionality), Analytical Cookies (to understand usage patterns), Preference Cookies (to remember your choices), and Marketing Cookies (to show relevant promotions).

sections.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
sections.content: You can manage or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings. However, disabling essential cookies may impact certain website features like online booking and inquiry forms.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.content: In some cases, we use cookies provided by trusted third parties such as Google Analytics to help us understand how pet parents use our site and how we can improve our services.

sections.title: Updates to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in technology, law, or our operations. Please review this page regularly for the latest information.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Cookie Policy, please contact us at privacy@dodocares.com or call us directly.

cookiePolicySec.footerNote: Thank you for trusting Dodo Cares with your furry family members.
cookiePolicySec.footerSubnote: We are here to provide the best care, every time.
